review: ID with decent debuffs that are hard to apply due to LCCB Rodion having low clash values, needing to have her skill fulfil various requirements that are prone to be messed up by speed distribution. It makes her unreliable to use. Even her passives are not that good because there are not many enemies who use defensive skills often. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
